title: Does what it is supposed to do, just not sure how long it will last.
text: Does what it is supposed to do, just not sure how long it will last.. I needed a new toilet brush, so I ordered this one by Joybos. It does a decent job. It comes with two brushes, with firm (slightly spread) bristles, and a base to store it in. The base pops open and closed easily. It cleans the toilet well. However, I only give this set a 3. Why? Because I am not sure how durable it will be. It is made of plastic and seems at time to be a little flimsy. For now, it is opening and closing, but I am not sure that it will work that well in a few months.
